the Humanoid Robot
A Humanoid Robot That Makes the Room Look Twice
Book Your Robot Experience
Meet Tai, our AGIBOT X2 Ultra humanoid robot for events.
Tai is compact, expressive, and built for interaction. He brings the kind of “wait, is that a real robot?” moment that event planners are always trying to create, without needing a massive footprint or a complicated setup.
At about 4 feet 3 inches tall, Tai is smaller than an adult but still has a strong in-person presence. That size makes him approachable for guests, easy to place at events, and perfect for photo moments, sponsor activations, trade show booths, corporate events, conferences, and brand experiences.
Contact Us
Why Tai Works So Well at any Events
Natural, fluid interaction
— Advanced AI-driven movement lets Tai walk, gesture, and engage guests in ways that feel life-like rather than mechanical.
Conversational AI
— Built-in voice and language capabilities mean Tai can greet, chat, and respond to guests in real time, creating genuine two-way engagement.
Customizable activations
— Tai can be programmed for activations tailored to your event's theme and brand.
Reliable, repeatable performance
— Every interaction is purpose-built and tested in advance, so Tai delivers a smooth, polished experience every time.
Scalable for any event size
— Whether it's an intimate brand activation or a large-scale trade show floor, Tai adapts to the space and the crowd.
Big Crowd Reaction.
What Can tai Do at Your Event?
Draw People Into a Booth
At a trade show, attention is everything. Tai gives attendees a reason to pause, look over, and start a conversation. He can help your booth feel more active before your team even says a word.
Create a Sponsor Moment
Tai can be positioned near branded signage, a product display, step-and-repeat area, or activation zone. He gives sponsors something more exciting than a logo on a banner.
Welcome Guests
Place Tai near registration, an entrance, a VIP check-in area, or a networking space to make arrivals feel more memorable.
Add Energy Between Sessions
Conferences and corporate events often have slow moments between speakers, meals, and breakout sessions. Tai gives guests something fun to experience while they move through the event.
Encourage Photos and Social Sharing
Guests love seeing something unexpected. Tai naturally encourages photos, videos, and “you have to see this” reactions.
Best Event Uses for Tai
Tai is a strong fit for:
Corporate events
Trade shows and expos
Conferences and conventions
Product launches
Grand openings
Sales meetings
Tech events
Brand activations
Sponsor experiences
Fundraisers and galas
Hospitality events
Private VIP events
He works best when your goal is visibility, guest engagement, media attention, or a memorable first impression.
FAQs
Is Tai good for trade shows?
Yes. Tai is a great trade show attraction because he helps create booth traffic, guest curiosity, and easy conversation starters.
Can Tai move around the event?
Tai has walking and movement capabilities, but how he moves at an event depends on the venue, flooring, crowd size, and safety plan. Our team will recommend the best setup for your space.
Can Tai interact with guests?
Yes. Tai includes interaction features such as an interactive screen, lighting effects, microphone, speaker, cameras, and movement capabilities. The exact experience can be planned around your event goals.
Is Tai staffed?
Yes. Bots-4-Events provides trained staff for Tai. We handle setup, operation, and guest flow support.
What types of events are best for Tai?
Tai works well for corporate events, conferences, trade shows, expos, product launches, grand openings, sponsor activations, galas, and brand experiences.
Can Tai be paired with other Bots-4-Events experiences?
Yes. Tai can be paired with
SelfieBot
,
DrawMeBot
,
KAI
and
RoboDog
experiences to create a larger robotic or AI-powered event activation.
How do we book Tai?
Fill out our contact form with your event date, location, event type, and what kind of experience you want to create. We will follow up with availability and next steps.
Ready to

He brings attention to the room without making the experience feel complicated.
He gives guests a reason to stop.
And he gives your event something people will want to share.
